name: – Konstantinos Arvanitis – § 91 – Am 5
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2025 Rule of Law report
part_text: 91. Expresses grave concern about the lack of transparency regarding EU funding to NGOs; notes with concern reports that the Commission has financed NGOs for campaigns, public advocacy and litigation, including activities aimed at influencing regulatory outcomes in favour of specific policy objectives, without public disclosure of contractual arrangements or funding criteria; stresses that substantial amounts are disbursed annually to NGOs without publication of contracts, transparent allocation mechanisms or adequate oversight, creating risks of political instrumentalisation of taxpayer money and conflicts of interest; calls on the Commission to ensure full public disclosure of all EU funding to NGOs, including contract details, funding criteria and performance monitoring, and to refrain from financing activities that serve particular political objectives rather than the general public interest;
